channel.title: The Moscow Times - Independent News From Russia
channel.description: The Moscow Times offers everything you need to know about Russia: Breaking news, top stories, business, analysis, opinion, multimedia

item.title: IT Worker Jailed 13 Years in Russia After Binance Revealed He Donated Money to Ukraine
item.description: Binance provided Russian investigators with Yury Belenky's transaction history last year, including records of transfers to Ukrainian fundraising campaigns.

item.title: Kremlin-Linked Businessman Joined Donald Trump Jr. on Mongolian Hunting Trip This Summer – FT
item.description: Businessman Umar Kremlev was previously revealed to have partly funded Trump Jr.’s wedding on a private Caribbean island in May.

item.description: The Russian president also confirmed potential joint energy projects with the United States in the Arctic.

item.title: In His Reporting, Japanese Journalist Yuki Imai Revealed a Fascination With Russia. Then He Was Arrested.

item.description: For months, Turkey has tried to negotiate a maritime security agreement between Russia and Ukraine.

item.title: Award-Winning Production Designer Dies at Moscow Hospital After Arrest for Treason

item.title: Ukrainian Drone Barrage Kills At Least 3 in Voronezh

item.title: Moscow to Host 2030 World Weightlifting Championships, IWF Says

item.title: Saudi Arabia Will Not Host Russia’s Intervision Song Contest This Year, TASS Reports
item.description: The decision leaves the future of Russia’s alternative to Eurovision uncertain a year after Moscow revived the Soviet-era competition.

item.title: Starlink in Ukraine Back to Normal After Week of Throttling

item.description: The Tolyattikauchuk petrochemical plant is one of Russia's largest producers of synthetic rubber.

item.title: 3 Tankers of Russian Diesel Headed for North America, Russian Deputy PM Says

item.title: Russia, U.S. Deny That American Hubbard Was Released in Exchange for Russian War Blogger

item.title: Moscow's Sheremetyevo Airport Resumes Operations After Ukrainian Drone Threat
item.description: Three of Moscow's airports had temporarily suspended flight operations on Friday.

item.title: Russian Subsidiary of German Retailer Metro Donates $12M to Military Fund

item.title: Romania Blames Russia for Deadly Drone Attack on Cargo Ship

item.title: FSB Orders Critical Infrastructure Operators to Shutter Websites Over PHP Bug – RBC

item.title: Russia and Ukraine Exchange 540 POWs

item.title: Russian Central Bank Holds Key Interest Rate Steady

item.title: Russia Vows Retaliation After Austria Expels Its Diplomats

item.title: First Shipment of Russian Diesel Departs for the United States Under Trump Deal
item.description: The tanker, loaded with 40,000 metric tons of ultra-low sulphur diesel, is expected to arrive in the United States on Nov. 7.

item.title: Moscow to Present New ‘Anti-Drone Dome’ at Upcoming Russia-Africa Summit
item.description: The upcoming presentation for Moscow’s African partners comes as Russia itself continues to struggle against Ukrainian drone attacks that have repeatedly overwhelmed air defense systems.

item.title: She Was a Leading Arctic Ornithologist. Now She’s Imprisoned for $25 in Donations.

item.title: Putin Says Renewed Peace Talks Must Focus on Security for Russia, Ukraine and Europe Overall

item.title: Trump Says Musk Restored Ukraine's Starlink Access, Declines to Say if They Spoke

item.title: Moscow to Build ‘Veterans Palace’ Rehab Center for Ukraine War Vets

item.title: Regions Calling: More Questions Than Answers After Latest Black Sea Oil Spill

item.title: As the Kremlin Seizes Control of European Companies, U.S. Rivals Remain Largely Spared

item.title: Solzhenitsyn Statue Temporarily Returned to Original Vladivostok Site After Relocation Mishap
